Class CursorIterator

public inherited sharing class CursorIterator

Iterator wrapper for Database.Cursor that simplifies paginated record fetching. Maintains iteration state (position, batch size) and provides convenient methods for traversing cursor results in batches. Supports fluent API for configuration.

Group:
    Utilities

Since:
